newsitem.title: USA: Times Mirror's Newsday circulation up.
newsitem.headline: Times Mirror's Newsday circulation up.

text.p: Newsday, a Long Island, New York newspaper published by Times Mirror Co, reported on Thursday higher daily and Sunday six month circulation, according to a statement filed with an audit bureau.
In the March 1997 Publisher's Statement filed with the Audit Bureau of Circulations, the newspaper said circulation increased 4,030 daily and 3,025 Sunday compared to the same six months last year.
The filing showed a total circulation of 559,233 daily and 646,446 for Sunday, the newspaper said.

Newsday publisher Raymond Jansen credited the circulation gains to improved customer service, a 0530 EDT delivery, a redesigned Sunday newspaper, a new Monday business section, credit card billing and marketing.
